intro: Denmark is a constitutional monarchy with one of the oldest royal families in the world and a parliamentary democracy.

chapters.title: King and Folketing
text: King Frederik X is head of state. The single-chamber parliament, the Folketing, has 179 members, including two each from Greenland and the Faroe Islands, and chooses the government. Mette Frederiksen became prime minister in 2019 and began a third term in June 2026 after record-long coalition talks.

chapters.title: Denmark in the world
text: Denmark is a founding member of NATO and has been in the EU since 1973, but uses its own currency, the krone, instead of the euro.

items.title: Signed
